_comment: Chapter 04: every call the PIM role settings code makes, with the least-privileged Graph permission from the Learn page for that call, read on October 30, 2026. Reads and writes are separate tasks: pim-plan only reads; pim-apply adds the two writes for role settings and eligibility; pim-convert adds the removal of a standing assignment. Get-PaPimRequiredPermission returns the union for a task, and a test keeps it equal to the union of the task's calls. A call that isn't listed here, or a method other than the one listed, throws before anything is sent.

calls.delegatedRole: Global Reader, Security Operator, Security Reader, Security Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator
calls.note: Learn's Example 2: $filter on scopeId '/', scopeType 'DirectoryRole' and roleDefinitionId, with $expand=policy($expand=rules). One call per role returns the policy ID and all 17 rules.
